name: Admin Proposal Reopen From Expired
description: Recover an expired proposal by extending expires_at to a future date from /panel/proposals/:id/edit (General tab) or via the JSON re-import panel. The serializer no longer blocks re-saving when expires_at is unchanged, and ProposalService.reopen_if_unexpired auto-reverts status from 'expired' to 'viewed' (when view_count > 0) or 'sent', logging an 'Auto-reopened from expired…' entry in ProposalChangeLog. Covers both PATCH /proposals/:id/update/ and PUT /proposals/:id/update-from-json/ paths.
